caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular picture frame with elaborate decorative elements, rendered in shades of gray, silver, and accents of reddish-pink. The frame is outlined by a series of straight and rounded segments with circular medallions at each corner and at the midpoints of the top and bottom sides. The circular medallions contain radiating patterns and central round shapes in a lighter gray or white hue. The vertical and horizontal segments of the frame are embellished with symmetrical leaf-like or petal motifs in gray with reddish-pink highlights. The upper central part of the frame is topped with a fan-shaped or shell-like ornament, featuring radiating lines and a central circular detail. The background is plain and off-white. The artist's signature is present in red near the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Cut Tin Picture Frame
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
